reviewedSourceContract.review: Literal source expectations extracted independently of renderer outputs. Each handled construct has an explicit semantic interpretation; every remaining construct blocks a complete source contract. No reference-renderer result supplies an expected answer.

sourceReview.method: Independent literal syntax transcription with fail-closed unhandled-construct accounting; source-specific regression and mutation controls in tests/docs-source-review.test.ts

inspection.method: Actual retained PNG directly inspected with view_image at native dimensions against complete current source facts; bounded pixel measurements recorded separately

review.reviewedBy: OpenAI Codex independent offline full-source/actual-PNG review, 2026-11-01
review.review: Fresh native-size actual PNG inspection against the complete current source contract: Forces title; all Legacy/Modern/AI labels and distinct component circles; component positions respectively visibility/evolution [.20,.85], [.55,.60], [.70,.35] in the independently measured axis frame; unobscured owned Legacy-to-Modern and Modern-to-AI links; visibility increases upward and evolution rightward. AI Adoption is the separate right-facing accelerator and Legacy Constraints the separate left-facing deaccelerator, with complete legible captions. The only prior unresolved fact, exact force position, is now established by independently measured physical arrow geometry under the approved positive-only source-versioned profile wardley-published-start-baseline-and-force-left-anchor-1fb7869-v1: AI Adoption actual physical anchor [248.9533971291866, 274.5] versus literal projected [249.00238465701528, 274.80038647635166] (absolute errors [0.04898752782867177, 0.3003864763516617] px); Legacy Constraints actual physical anchor [651.0721064301549, 476.5] versus literal projected [651.0007948856718, 476.40073001088655] (absolute errors [0.07131154448313737, 0.09926998911345208] px). frame-force-measurements.json pins actual PNG hashes and gray-axis frame, shaft centerlines, tail pixels and head-slope intersections. Expected literal positions are applied only after measurement; actual SVG positions, paired renderer agreement and default styles are not used. No source fact is removed or transformed; no renderer call or timing claim.
